mechanics: Replaces PackCompatibility.isCompatible's returned value with true, hiding incompatibility handling wherever callers use that query. The initializer is empty.
risks: A pack can be reported compatible without its resource format actually being understood. This suppresses a check, not a resource migration.
validation: Check too-old/too-new pack formats, real load errors, and every caller affected by the substituted query.

mechanics: Returns false from a renderer's PojavLauncher detection and cancels its LWJGL runtime version check.
risks: Suppressing environment checks does not supply missing graphics/runtime capabilities. Renderer class/method contracts can change across versions.
validation: Verify actual backend/LWJGL support and behavior after check suppression on the targeted launcher.
podium.fit: Launcher compatibility bypass; not an optimization algorithm.

mechanics: Wraps the hurt-direction read during camera render-state extraction. If damage has no source position, indirect entity, or direct entity, chooses a random zero/180-degree direction once per DamageSource instance and reuses it during that hit.
risks: Changes camera tilt for nondirectional damage. Caching by DamageSource identity and consuming the entity RNG can differ from the intended original behavior.
validation: Check directional/non-directional sources, repeated damage-source instances, hurt-time transitions, and camera animation.
nondirectionaldamagetiltfix.fit: Camera bug fix/visual behavior change, not general performance optimization.

mechanics: After successful client-side block-item placement, reads the placed state and invokes the ordinary destroy-block particle effect when the state is non-air.
risks: Adds particles and rendering/simulation work; does not reduce work. Success-result and placed-position semantics matter for special placement items.
validation: Check successful/failed/multiblock placements, client/server duplication, particle settings, and special block items.
breaking-place.fit: Additional visual effect; excluded from optimization candidates.

mechanics: Tracks how long the use key is held with wall-clock time. After 200 milliseconds, clears Minecraft.rightClickDelay every client tick; releasing use resets the hold timer.
risks: Changes action repeat rate and can increase network/action work. Wall-clock adjustments and screen/item behavior can change timing.
validation: Check hold/release, GUI use, different use items, server rate limits, and clock adjustments.
better-place-bind.fit: Input/gameplay repeat behavior, not cheaper frames.

mechanics: After holding attack for 200 milliseconds, clears missTime each tick and calls startAttack while no GUI screen is open. Releasing attack resets the timer.
risks: Changes attack repeat/miss cooldown behavior and can issue additional actions. It does not remove rendering cost.
validation: Test held attacks against entities/blocks/air, GUI transitions, key rebindings, and server action handling.

mechanics: Suppresses ChunkMap.tick at its ServerChunkCache.tick call site, then invokes that method through an accessor at the tail of ServerLevel.tick.
risks: Moves entity tracking/network updates to a different tick phase. Every relevant call path must tick exactly once, including exceptional/paused/skipped paths.
validation: Compare impulse/position packets and tracker timing, count calls per world tick, and test pause/freeze/dimension transitions.
enttick.fit: Server update-order fix; no direct work-count/FPS reduction established.

mechanics: A key binding toggles a client flag and status overlay. When enabled, Style.isObfuscated always returns false, exposing the original characters rather than randomized obfuscated glyph rendering.
risks: Changes displayed text and server-intended presentation. The scope applies to every style query, not only selected player labels.
validation: Check chat, labels, UI, all style inheritance, and toggle changes in cached text rendering.
deobfuscator.fit: Text presentation utility; excluded from unchanged visuals.

mechanics: At fog setup completion, sets render-distance and environmental fog end to a very large float except for blindness/darkness and water/lava/powder-snow fog cases.
risks: Changes atmospheric visuals and can expose/render work previously hidden by fog. Capturing specific local variables is version-fragile.
validation: Check dimensions, weather, effects, fluid/submersion cases, fog starts/ends, and local capture layout.
the-nofog-mod.fit: Fog removal; not unchanged-visuals performance optimization.

betterclock.scope: All three reconstructed source files reviewed, including the nested phase enum.
mechanics: On a rising use-key edge while holding a clock, converts overworld clock ticks to day/hour/minute and one of four phase labels, then sends a formatted message.
Uses floor division/modulo for negative time and suppresses repeated messages while the key remains held.
risks: Adds a small per-tick input check and message behavior. The four equal tick partitions' phase labels may differ from visual dawn/dusk timing.
validation: Check time boundaries/negative ticks, offhand clocks, held keys, leaving worlds, and custom time progression.
betterclock.fit: Informational UI utility, not performance optimization.

mechanics: On server-side, empty-main-hand sneaking interaction with a wooden shelf, toggles align_items_to_bottom using a block data-modification command executed from the server command source.
risks: Changes shelf presentation/state and uses server-level command authority after only interaction checks. Region permissions/protection callbacks and data synchronization need verification.
validation: Check protected blocks, hand/sneak conditions, shelf variants, client sync, and command/schema failure.
